{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2009–10 |team=Tulsa Golden Hurricane |image=Tulsa Golden Hurricane logo.svg |conference=Conference USA |division= |short_conf=C-USA |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=23–12 |conf_record=10–6 |head_coach=[[Doug Wojcik]] |asst_coach1=David Cason |asst_coach2=[[Jeremy Ballard]] |asst_coach3=Andy Kohut |stadium=[[Reynolds Center]] |champion=[[2010 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] First Round |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2009–10 Conference USA men's basketball standings}} The '''2009–10 Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Tulsa]] in the [[2009–10 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2009–10]] [[college basketball]] season. This was head coach [[Doug Wojcik]]'s fifth season at Tulsa. The Golden Hurricane competed in [[2009–10 Conference USA men's basketball season|Conference USA]] and played their home games at the [[Reynolds Center]]. They finished the season 23–12, 10–6 in CUSA play, lost in the semifinals of the [[2010 Conference USA men's basketball tournament]] and were invited to the [[2010 National Invitation Tournament]] where they lost in the first round. ==Roster== Source{{Cite web |url=http://www.tulsahurricane.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/tuls-m-baskbl-mtt.html |title=The University of Tulsa Official Athletic Site - Men's Basketball |access-date=2010-01-25 |archive-date=2011-07-22 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110722061131/http://www.tulsahurricane.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/tuls-m-baskbl-mtt.html |url-status=dead }} {| class="wikitable" style="font-size: 90%" !# !Name !Height !Weight (lbs.) !Position !Class !Hometown !Previous Team(s) |- |1 |[[Ben Uzoh]] |6'3" |205 |[[Guard (basketball)|G]] |Sr. |[[San Antonio, TX]], [[United States|U.S.]] |[[Earl Warren High School|Warren HS]] |- |2 |Bryson Pope |6'6" |210 |[[Guard (basketball)|G]]/[[Forward (basketball)|F]] |Fr. |[[Jenks, OK]], [[United States|U.S.]] |[[Jenks Public Schools|Jenks HS]] |- |4 |Shane Heirman |6'1" |195 |[[Guard (basketball)|G]] |Jr. |[[McHenry, IL]], [[United States|U.S.]] |[[Marian Central Catholic High School|Marian Central Catholic HS]]
